_comment: DOUBLER COMBAT PAY -- the deferred doublers' ATTACKER must survive main's payments (Morph INT-16 A/B finding, seed 97000
gi 18 turn 4). Ignoble Hierarch (the only creature), Wild Defiance, Stomping Ground + Fire-Lit Thicket untapped; Might

in MAIN: Might (+3 Wild Defiance, +4) = 7, Berserk (+3) = 10 doubled = 20, exalted +1 = 21. The first exact probe took
P2 (Berserk paid first off the lands, then Might's main payment tapped the Hierarch) as valid -> no attacker, no kill
(opponent at 11). Fixed: an option whose held attacker is tapped once main has paid is invalid. (=0 credits a phantom
22 -- Berserk 'in combat' off the Hierarch -- and also wins on turn 4.)
